"""RT-062eb8 J3 review computation: the matched-marginal shuffle rule of
EXP-BINSTD-de9678 against the marginal-skew artifact of audit 2 (OC-1).

REVIEW COMPUTATION ONLY. Toy size. Mints no RUN-*, writes no evidence record,
executes no EXP-BINSTD-de9678 driver as an experiment. Two functions
(bucket_gain, matched_marginal_shuffle) are transcribed VERBATIM from the
audit sheet's fixture_code block as the OBJECT UNDER TEST; nothing else of the
fixture is used, and no gate driver, cell builder or curve arithmetic is run.

Deterministic: every seed is a literal below.
"""
import math
import random
import time

# ===================================================================
# OBJECT UNDER TEST, transcribed verbatim from
# coordination/.../TASK-20260928-6880fc/proof-search-map-audit.yaml
# fixture_code (FIXTURE-B1), functions bucket_gain and
# matched_marginal_shuffle. Unchanged.
# ===================================================================
MIN_CELL = 100


def bucket_gain(pairs, h, M):
    """G == M * max over (a,b,c) of Pr[h(P+Q) == c | h(P) == a, h(Q) == b].
    Conditioning cells with fewer than MIN_CELL samples are excluded and
    counted."""
    tot, cnt = {}, {}
    for P, Q, S in pairs:
        a, b, c = h(P), h(Q), h(S)
        tot[(a, b)] = tot.get((a, b), 0) + 1
        cnt[(a, b, c)] = cnt.get((a, b, c), 0) + 1
    best, used, excluded = 0.0, 0, 0
    for (a, b), nab in tot.items():
        if nab < MIN_CELL:
            excluded += 1
            continue
        used += 1
        for c in range(M):
            v = cnt.get((a, b, c), 0) / nab
            if v > best:
                best = v
    return M * best, used, excluded


def matched_marginal_shuffle(pairs, h, M, seed=0):
    """Permute bucket labels among buckets of EQUAL marginal frequency, so
    every marginal is preserved exactly and only the propagation content
    can be destroyed."""
    marg = {}
    for P, Q, S in pairs:
        for R in (P, Q, S):
            b = h(R)
            marg[b] = marg.get(b, 0) + 1
    groups = {}
    for b in range(M):
        groups.setdefault(marg.get(b, 0), []).append(b)
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    perm = {}
    for _freq, members in groups.items():
        shuffled = members[:]
        rng.shuffle(shuffled)
        for src, dst in zip(members, shuffled):
            perm[src] = dst

    def h2(P):
        return perm[h(P)]

    return h2
# =================== end of transcribed object ======================


def my_histogram_shuffle(points, h, M, seed):
    """MY implementation of what RT-EXP-1 (KN-FIND-ffe1df) describes and what
    OC-1 needs: reassign bucket values ACROSS POINTS uniformly at random
    subject to the EXACT bucket-size histogram. Marginals are preserved
    exactly; every arithmetic relation between h(P), h(Q), h(P+Q) is
    destroyed. This is the discriminating shuffle; it is NOT the contract's."""
    vals = [h(p) for p in points]
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    rng.shuffle(vals)
    table = dict(zip(points, vals))
    return lambda P: table[P]


def cyclic_pairs(N, S, seed):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    out = []
    for _ in range(S):
        x = rng.randrange(N)
        y = rng.randrange(N)
        out.append((x, y, (x + y) % N))
    return out


def report(tag, G, used, exc):
    print("  %-34s G = %.6f   cells_used = %d  cells_excluded = %d"
          % (tag, G, used, exc))


print("=" * 72)
print("PART 1. ALGEBRAIC FACT: G is INVARIANT under any relabelling of the")
print("alphabet, so a label permutation cannot destroy any reading.")
print("=" * 72)
print("""
Proof. Let pi be a bijection of the alphabet and h' = pi o h. Then
  Pr[h'(P+Q)=c | h'(P)=a, h'(Q)=b]
      = Pr[h(P+Q)=pi^-1(c) | h(P)=pi^-1(a), h(Q)=pi^-1(b)],
and (a,b,c) -> (pi^-1 a, pi^-1 b, pi^-1 c) is a bijection of the index set,
so the maximum over (a,b,c) is the SAME NUMBER. Hence G(h') = G(h) exactly,
for every h, every sample and every M. The transcribed
matched_marginal_shuffle returns exactly pi o h for a bijection pi of the
bucket labels (it permutes labels within classes of equal marginal COUNT),
so G_shuffle == G identically. Moreover when the observed marginal counts of
two buckets are distinct -- the generic case, and the certain case for the
M = 2 exact control h2 in any sample with unequal bucket counts -- every
class is a singleton and pi is the IDENTITY map.
""")

N = 4 * 137 * 239          # 130972, the composite toy order, used as Z/N
S = 1 << 16                # toy sample size for this part
pairs = cyclic_pairs(N, S, seed=11)
points = sorted({p for tr in pairs for p in tr[:3]})
print("cell: Z/%d (cyclic model), S = 2^%d ordered pairs, seed 11"
      % (N, int(math.log2(S))))
print("distinct points touched: %d" % len(points))

print("\n-- 1a. EXACT filter h(x) = x mod 4 (alphabet 4, a true homomorphism)")
h_exact = lambda x: x % 4
G, u, e = bucket_gain(pairs, h_exact, 4)
report("direct", G, u, e)
hs = matched_marginal_shuffle(pairs, h_exact, 4, seed=7)
Gs, us, es = bucket_gain(pairs, hs, 4)
report("contract shuffle (labels)", Gs, us, es)
identity_perm = all(hs(p) == h_exact(p) for p in points)
print("  contract shuffle is the IDENTITY map on this arm: %s" % identity_perm)
hm = my_histogram_shuffle(points, h_exact, 4, seed=7)
Gm, um, em = bucket_gain([(p, q, s) for p, q, s in pairs], hm, 4)
report("histogram shuffle (mine)", Gm, um, em)
print("  PC-6 asks the shuffle to bring the exact reading below 1 + null width.")
print("  contract shuffle: %.6f  -> PC-6 %s" % (Gs, "FAILS" if Gs > 1.5 else "passes"))
print("  histogram shuffle: %.6f -> PC-6 %s" % (Gm, "FAILS" if Gm > 1.5 else "passes"))

print("\n-- 1b. MARGINAL-SKEW ARTIFACT (OC-1): a filter with a binomial")
print("       marginal and ZERO propagation content, by construction.")
M = 16
binom = [math.comb(M - 1, i) for i in range(M)]
tot = sum(binom)
probs = [b / tot for b in binom]
art_table = {}


def h_art(x):
    """Random function of the point with a Binomial(M-1,1/2) bucket profile.
    Lazily populated, deterministically keyed on the point, so it is defined
    on every point any sample can reach."""
    if x not in art_table:
        u01 = random.Random(4242 ^ (x * 2654435761)).random()
        acc, lab = 0.0, M - 1
        for i, pr in enumerate(probs):
            acc += pr
            if u01 <= acc:
                lab = i
                break
        art_table[x] = lab
    return art_table[x]
print("  h is a RANDOM function of the point (no arithmetic content at all)")
print("  with bucket probabilities Binomial(%d, 1/2)/norm; heaviest bucket"
      % (M - 1))
print("  probability p_max = %.6f against 1/M = %.6f" % (max(probs), 1.0 / M))
G_art, u, e = bucket_gain(pairs, h_art, M)
report("artifact, direct", G_art, u, e)
hs_art = matched_marginal_shuffle(pairs, h_art, M, seed=7)
G_art_s, us, es = bucket_gain(pairs, hs_art, M)
report("artifact, contract shuffle", G_art_s, us, es)
hm_art = my_histogram_shuffle(points, h_art, M, seed=7)
G_art_m, um, em = bucket_gain(pairs, hm_art, M)
report("artifact, histogram shuffle", G_art_m, um, em)
print("  predicted G of a pure marginal artifact is about M*p_max = %.4f"
      % (M * max(probs)))

print("\n-- 1c. A GENUINE reading at the SAME alphabet M = %d, for contrast:" % M)
print("       the exact filter h(x) = x mod %d (M divides N)." % M)
print("       N mod 16 = %d, so use M = 4 instead where 4 | N; and separately")
print("       Here we use the approximate log-interval key on Z/l as the")
print("       genuine-signal stand-in (see PART 2 of the PTM script).")

print("\n-- 1d. THE READING THE RULE PRODUCES")
print("""
  artifact : preserved by the contract shuffle (G_shuffle = G exactly)
             -> the rule labels it a marginal artifact. CORRECT LABEL.
  exact    : ALSO preserved (G_shuffle = G = M exactly)
             -> PC-6 fails, IR-6 fires: "the shuffle is not functioning as a
                null and every Stage 2 arm on that cell is invalid".
  So the rule reaches the right verdict on the artifact for the WRONG reason:
  it preserves everything, and therefore discriminates nothing. The same
  invariance closes SR-4 clause 3 (G_shuffle - 1 below the null width), which
  no arm meeting clause 1 (G - 1 at least 3 null widths) can ever satisfy.
""")

print("=" * 72)
print("PART 2. SR-4 clause 3 is unsatisfiable jointly with clause 1.")
print("=" * 72)
print("""
Clause 1: G - 1 >= 3 * null_width. Clause 3: G_shuffle - 1 < null_width.
Under the transcribed shuffle G_shuffle = G, so clause 3 reads
G - 1 < null_width, which contradicts clause 1 for any positive null_width.
Therefore NO reading whatever can meet the pre-registered LEAD threshold of
SR-4 as the contract commits it. Demonstrated numerically on the artifact arm:
""")
# a bootstrap width on the random-label arm for scale, small resample count
def bootstrap_width(pairs, h, M, resamples, seed):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    n = len(pairs)
    vals = []
    for _ in range(resamples):
        sample = [pairs[rng.randrange(n)] for _ in range(n)]
        g, _u, _e = bucket_gain(sample, h, M)
        vals.append(g)
    vals.sort()
    lo = vals[int(0.025 * resamples)]
    hi = vals[int(0.975 * resamples) - 1]
    return lo, hi, hi - lo

null_table = {}


def h_null(x):
    if x not in null_table:
        null_table[x] = random.Random(999 ^ (x * 40503)).randrange(M)
    return null_table[x]
G_null, _u, _e = bucket_gain(pairs, h_null, M)
lo, hi, width = bootstrap_width(pairs, h_null, M, 40, seed=5)
print("  random-label arm at M = %d: G = %.6f, 95pc interval (%.6f, %.6f),"
      % (M, G_null, lo, hi))
print("  width = %.6f   [40 resamples here, not the contract's 1000]" % width)
print("  artifact: G - 1 = %.6f  which is %.2f null widths"
      % (G_art - 1, (G_art - 1) / width))
print("  artifact: G_shuffle - 1 = %.6f  which is %.2f null widths"
      % (G_art_s - 1, (G_art_s - 1) / width))
print("  clause 1 met: %s ; clause 3 met: %s"
      % ((G_art - 1) >= 3 * width, (G_art_s - 1) < width))
print("  exact h(x) = x mod 4: G_shuffle - 1 = %.6f, clause 3 met: %s"
      % (Gs - 1, (Gs - 1) < width))

print("=" * 72)
print("PART 3. COST of the mandatory 1000-resample bootstrap, measured.")
print("=" * 72)
S_t = 1 << 14
pt = cyclic_pairs(N, S_t, seed=3)
t0 = time.time()
bucket_gain(pt, h_art, M)
t1 = time.time()
one = t1 - t0
print("  one bucket_gain pass at S = 2^%d : %.4f s (pure Python, one core)"
      % (int(math.log2(S_t)), one))
per_pair = one / S_t
print("  per pair-visit: %.3e s" % per_pair)
for Sx in (1 << 18, 1 << 20):

class F2n:
    def __init__(self, n, mod):
        self.n, self.mod, self.q = n, mod, 1 << n

    def mul(self, a, b):
        r = 0
        while b:
            if b & 1:
                r ^= a
            a <<= 1
            b >>= 1
        dm = self.mod.bit_length() - 1
        while r and r.bit_length() - 1 >= dm:
            r ^= self.mod << (r.bit_length() - 1 - dm)
        return r

    def sqr(self, a):
        return self.mul(a, a)

    def pw(self, a, e):
        r, x = 1, a
        while e:
            if e & 1:
                r = self.mul(r, x)
            x = self.sqr(x)
            e >>= 1
        return r

    def inv(self, a):
        return self.pw(a, self.q - 2)

    def tr(self, a):
        s, x = 0, a
        for _ in range(self.n):
            s ^= x
            x = self.sqr(x)
        return s

    def half_trace(self, a):
        s, x = 0, a
        for _ in range((self.n - 1) // 2 + 1):
            s ^= x
            x = self.sqr(self.sqr(x))
        return s

        x = a

            x = self.sqr(x)
        return x

    cur = 2
    for _ in range(n):

    r = 0
    b = a

    while b:

            r ^= a << sh
        b >>= 1
        sh += 1
    return r

        if i < n and n % i == 0 and i > 0:

    return cur == 2
